titlebar.welcome_sub: Press your hotkey anytime to open the module menu.
titlebar.run_on_startup_desc: Start automatically in the background when Windows boots.
titlebar.auto_updates_desc: Check for updates every time the app launches.
titlebar.hotkey_desc: Press a combination to open the quick action menu anywhere.
titlebar.language_desc: Interface language. Applies instantly to every screen.
updater.checking_sub: Establishing a secure connection to the BurnedWolf network…
updater.available_sub: An updated build is ready. Installing only takes a few seconds and your settings will be preserved.
updater.installing_sub: Please don't close the window — this only takes a moment.
updater.uptodate_sub: BurnedWolf is up to date. Redirecting to the main interface…
updater.error_sub: Check your internet connection and try again. If your DNS was left broken by a crash, the repair button below usually fixes it.
exit.title: Terminating Session
exit.sub: Closing secure tunnels and clearing network hooks…
exit.footer: It's safe to close — all background processes will be terminated.
onboard.lang_sub: Pick the language you want BurnedWolf to use. You can change it later in settings.
onboard.update_sub: Should BurnedWolf check for updates automatically on every launch? You can change this later in settings.
onboard.update_yes_desc: Recommended. Always run the latest features and security fixes.
onboard.update_no_desc: Skip the update check at startup. You can still update manually anytime.
onboard.footer: Welcome to BurnedWolf · Setting things up
spotlight.empty: No modules found matching your query.
spotlight.module_dpi_desc: Open the DPI shield control panel.
spotlight.module_verify_desc: Open file verification and repair tool.
spotlight.warning_banner: Your game might be running in exclusive fullscreen mode. Switch to 'Borderless Windowed' for seamless overlay.
dpi.isp_hint_default: Recommended profiles are marked with ★ in the dropdown.
dpi.isp_hint_unknown: Public IP lookup failed. Pick a profile manually from the dropdown.
dpi.failover_hint: Rotate to next recommended profile if Discord becomes unreachable.
dpi.failover_hint_disabled: Needs a known ISP with multiple recommended profiles.
dpi.terminal_ready: BurnedWolf shield module ready. Awaiting command.
dpi.whitelist_desc: Hostlist-Auto is active. Shield will only trigger on specified or automatically detected blocked domains.
dpi.tr_master_desc: Bundled list of Turkey-blocked / throttled domains (Discord, Roblox, YouTube, X, Mega, Twitch, Reddit, VPN sites). Applied as a second hostlist alongside your own — DPI bypass only triggers on these targets, leaving the rest of the web full-speed.
dpi.analysis_desc: Tests every profile against Discord, YouTube, X, Roblox, and Twitch — both HTTP/HTTPS and voice UDP. Synthesizes a custom mutation if no built-in profile passes (Deep mode only).
dpi.analysis_terminal_ready: System ready for analysis. Pick a scan mode above.
dns.ttnet_warning_desc: Türk Telekom intercepts DNS queries on port 53. Without Encrypted DNS, the DPI bypass cannot reach the correct servers.
dns.modal_desc: BurnedWolf will set this DNS on your active network adapter. You can revert to automatic at any time.
dns.doh_option: Use Encrypted DNS (DoH) — recommended for ISPs that hijack port 53
dns.dns_revert_failed: Could not revert DNS — please reset network adapter manually
dns.encrypted_start_failed: Encrypted DNS could not start (dnscrypt-proxy missing or port 53 in use)
discord.new_login_desc: Your account details are stored locally on this device only.
discord.saved_desc: A secure identity has been previously configured on the system.
verify.title: System Integrity Check
verify.desc: Verifies your local installation against the original server files and repairs any missing or corrupt components automatically.
verify.repaired_count: System firewall renewed. A total of {n} files were repaired.
verify.integrity_ok: Integrity verified at 100%. All files are original and no intervention was required.
home.stopped_sub: Select a profile and press Start
dns.head: DNS & encryption
dns.encrypted_desc: Runs dnscrypt-proxy locally and routes DNS over HTTPS. Best against ISP DNS hijacking.
dns.providers: Or pick a plain DNS provider
analysis.head: Network analysis
analysis.desc: Tests profiles against Discord, YouTube, X, Roblox and Twitch, then applies the best one as a Custom profile.
adv.head: Advanced
adv.failover_desc: Rotate through recommended profiles if Discord becomes unreachable.
adv.failover_unavailable: Needs a known ISP with multiple recommended profiles. Detection inconclusive — disabled.
adv.failover_ready: Rotate through {n} profiles if Discord becomes unreachable.
adv.trmaster_count: {n} domains bundled (Discord, Roblox, YouTube, X, Mega, Twitch, …).
adv.whitelist_desc: One domain per line. These get DPI bypass treatment.
settings.update_notes_desc: Show the changelog popup when the app opens.
settings.check_updates_desc: Look for a newer version right now.
settings.backup_desc: Export your settings and whitelist to a file, or import them back.
notes.title: What's new
builder.adv_desc: Build, clone, import and share your own DPI profiles.
builder.title: Profile builder
builder.name: Profile name
builder.quick_add_desc: Click to append a flag. Use “new chain” to start a separate filter block.
proxy.adv_desc: Share Tor with other apps as SOCKS/HTTP, or a PAC file.
proxy.title: Proxy bridge
proxy.intro: Route other apps through Tor — point them at one of these endpoints.
proxy.tor_off: Not running — start it to use the bridge
proxy.socks_desc: Best for browsers and SOCKS-aware apps. DNS resolves through Tor.
proxy.http_desc: For apps that only accept an HTTP proxy. Tunnels through Tor.
proxy.pac_desc: Point Windows or your browser’s automatic proxy config at this file.
bridges.adv_desc: Pluggable transports (obfs4 / snowflake) for when Tor is blocked.
bridges.title: Tor bridges
bridges.intro: Use pluggable transports when Tor itself is blocked. Needs the transport binary in the app’s tor-bin folder.
bridges.enable_desc: Route Tor through a pluggable transport.
bridges.lines_desc: One per line, from bridges.torproject.org or Tor Browser. Snowflake needs its one bridge line too.
bridges.help_body: Copy obfs4proxy.exe (or lyrebird.exe) and snowflake-client.exe from Tor Browser’s PluggableTransports folder into this app’s tor-bin folder.
stats.title: Statistics
home.health_idle: Starts measuring once protection is on
home.health_wait: First measurement in a few seconds
dns.hero_desc: Every site you visit starts with a DNS question. Turkish ISPs hijack port 53 to answer it themselves — encrypted DNS hides the question inside HTTPS so they can't.
dnsfix.check_sub: Making sure an interrupted encrypted-DNS session didn't leave your resolver stranded on 127.0.0.1.
dnsfix.title: Repair DoH residue
dnsfix.desc: If a crash or power cut left DNS pointing at 127.0.0.1 with nothing listening, this puts it back so the internet works again.
dnsfix.banner_text: Encrypted DNS didn't shut down cleanly, so nothing is resolving names. One click fixes it.
dnsfix.broken_sub: Your network adapter still resolves through 127.0.0.1 but nothing is listening there, so nothing will load. Repair it and BurnedWolf will carry on.
dnsfix.fixed_text: Your adapter was pointing at a dead local resolver. It's back to normal — continuing.
dnsfix.fixed_text_named: Repaired on: {a}. Your connection is back to normal.
dnsfix.none_text: Your DNS is configured correctly — no leftovers from encrypted DNS.
dnsfix.failed_text: Windows refused the change. Try again, or set your adapter's DNS to Automatic (DHCP) in network settings.
onboard.ai_sub: Connect any AI provider — several are completely free — and BurnedWolf AI will read your connection, pick the right bypass profile and configure the app for you. You can set it up at any time from the AI tab.
onboard.ai_yes_desc: Opens the provider list right after setup finishes.
onboard.ai_no_desc: Go straight to the app. The AI tab is always there when you want it.
ai.tile_sub: Let the AI run BurnedWolf for you
ai.hero_desc: Connect any AI provider and BurnedWolf AI can read your connection, pick the right bypass profile, fix DNS and configure the whole app for you — in your own words.
ai.enable_desc: Turns the AI assistant on. Needs a provider and a model.
ai.act_desc: Lets it start protection, switch profiles, fix DNS and edit settings itself. With this off it can only look and advise.
ai.settings_row_desc: Provider, model, API keys and usage limits.
ai.free.gemini_free: Free API key from Google AI Studio, no card. Generous daily quota — the easiest place to start.
ai.free.openai_free: Paid only: you must top up credit before the first request. Cheapest useful model is GPT-4.1 mini.
ai.free.anthropic_free: Paid only: needs credit on the account. Claude Haiku 4.5 is the cheapest capable option.
ai.free.xai_free: Paid, but xAI regularly hands out free monthly credits — check your console before topping up.
ai.free.openrouter_free: One key for every vendor. Models ending in ":free" cost nothing at all.
ai.free.groq_free: Free tier with a daily limit, and by far the fastest responses.
ai.free.deepseek_free: Paid, but roughly ten times cheaper than the big names. A dollar lasts a very long time.
ai.free.mistral_free: Free experiment tier after signing up. European provider.
ai.free.cohere_free: Free trial keys with a monthly limit, meant for testing.
ai.free.ollama_free: Runs entirely on your own PC. No key, no cost, no data leaves the machine — and it works while your connection is filtered.
ai.free.custom_free: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: a local server, a company gateway, or a provider not listed here.
ai.steps.gemini: Open Google AI Studio and sign in with any Google account.|Click "Create API key" — no billing details are asked for.|Copy the key (it starts with AIza) and paste it below.
ai.steps.openai: Open platform.openai.com and sign in.|Add credit under Billing — the API is separate from a ChatGPT Plus subscription and will not work without it.|Go to API keys → Create new secret key, then copy it (starts with sk-).
ai.steps.anthropic: Open console.anthropic.com and sign in.|Buy credit under Plans & Billing — a Claude.ai subscription does not cover API use.|Go to API Keys → Create Key and copy it (starts with sk-ant-).
ai.steps.xai: Open console.x.ai and sign in with your X account.|Create a team, then check whether free monthly credits are offered.|Under API Keys create a key and copy it (starts with xai-).
ai.steps.openrouter: Open openrouter.ai and sign in with Google or GitHub.|Go to Keys → Create Key and copy it (starts with sk-or-).|Pick any model whose name ends in ":free" to spend nothing.
ai.steps.groq: Open console.groq.com and sign in.|Go to API Keys → Create API Key.|Copy the key (starts with gsk_). The free tier is enabled immediately.
ai.steps.deepseek: Open platform.deepseek.com and register.|Top up a small amount under Billing — a couple of dollars goes a very long way here.|Create an API key and copy it.
ai.steps.mistral: Open console.mistral.ai and register.|Activate the free "Experiment" plan.|Go to API Keys, create one and copy it.
ai.steps.cohere: Open dashboard.cohere.com and register.|Copy the Trial key from the API Keys page.|Trial keys are rate-limited but free.
ai.steps.ollama: Download Ollama from ollama.com and install it.|Open a terminal and run: ollama pull llama3.1:8b|Leave Ollama running. No key is needed — just pick a model below.
ai.steps.custom: Enter the base URL of any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, ending in /v1.|Add the key it expects, if any.|Type the exact model id in the custom model box.
ai.steps.generic: Create an account with the provider, generate an API key and paste it below.
ai.how_to_key: How to get your API key
ai.key_desc: Stored encrypted with Windows DPAPI on this device only. It never leaves your machine except in requests to the provider you picked.
ai.key_store_fail: Windows encryption is unavailable, so the key can't be stored safely.
ai.no_models: No models returned. Save a valid key first, or type a model id manually.
ai.custom_model_desc: Know the exact model name? Type it here — useful for brand-new models that aren't listed yet.
ai.greet: I'm BurnedWolf AI. I can see your connection and this app's live state, and I can operate it for you — start protection, pick the right profile, fix DNS, run an analysis. What do you need?
ai.greet_isp: I can see you're on {isp}. I know which bypass profiles work best there, and I can set everything up for you — protection, DNS, analysis. What would you like me to do?
ai.s4: Which profile is best for my ISP?
ai.err_disabled: BurnedWolf AI is switched off. Turn it on in AI settings.
ai.err_not_configured: No provider or model selected yet. Pick one on the AI setup page.
ai.err_no_key: No API key saved for this provider. Add one on its setup page.
ai.err_no_endpoint: This provider has no endpoint configured.
ai.err_provider: That provider is no longer available.
ai.provider_limits_desc: Reported by your provider on the last request.
ai.free_tips_desc: Google AI Studio, Groq, OpenRouter's ":free" models and Mistral all have genuinely free quotas. Ollama runs on your own PC and costs nothing at all. Pick one of those on the provider page if you don't want to pay.
ai.audit_desc: This is exactly what gets attached to your message when you talk to the assistant. Nothing is sent anywhere until you press send.
ai.no_free_models: No free models from this provider. Switch to "All" or pick a provider with a free tier.
ai.quota.gemini: Free tier: no card required, limited requests per minute and per day. Enough for everyday use inside BurnedWolf.
ai.quota.groq: Free tier: every model below is free, with a daily request and token cap. No card required.
ai.quota.mistral: Free "Experiment" plan: every model below is free with rate limits. Needs phone verification, no card.
ai.quota.cohere: Trial key: every model below is free with a monthly cap. Intended for testing, not production.
ai.quota.openrouter: Free-ness is per model here. Models marked Free cost nothing; the rest bill from your credit.
ai.quota.ollama: No limit and no cost — the model runs on your own hardware. Speed depends on your PC.
analysis.empty_desc: Run an analysis and every profile gets tested against real sites. The winner is applied automatically.
verify.empty_desc: Every bundled file is compared against the original. Anything missing or altered is downloaded again.
home.log_empty_desc: Engine, DNS and Tor events appear here as they happen.
dnsfix.banner_text_partial: One adapter still resolves through 127.0.0.1 with nothing listening there. Other connections are covering for it, so some apps work and others fail. One click clears it.
home.err_sub: The engine could not start. Try another profile, or ask BurnedWolf AI.
donate.title: Support
donate.intro: BurnedWolf is free — no accounts, no ads, no tracking — and it stays that way. If it got your connection working, a donation covers what running it costs.
donate.address_hint: Scan the code with your wallet, or copy the address below. Bitcoin mainnet, native SegWit (bech32).
donate.copy_failed: Couldn't copy — select the address and copy it by hand
donate.no_wallet: No wallet app is set up for bitcoin: links — use the QR or the address
donate.what: Server and bandwidth for the update channel and the domain lists, the code-signing certificate, and the hours that go into keeping the DPI profiles working after each new block. Nothing in the app is gated behind a donation — every feature is on for everyone, whether you send anything or not.
donate.disclaimer: Donations are voluntary and cannot be refunded — a Bitcoin transaction is irreversible. Check the address before you send: it must match the one shown here character for character.
donate.sheet_intro: BurnedWolf is free — no accounts, no ads, no tracking. If it got your connection working, a donation covers what running it costs.
donate.settings_row_desc: Show the donation screen when the app opens. It stays reachable from the rail either way.
